headline: Tanzania Financial Markets Week to 20 November 2026: Shilling Weakens to TZS 2,660.71/USD, Interbank FX Turnover Jumps to USD 86.15 Million
summary: The shilling closed at TZS 2,660.71 per US dollar in the week to 20 November 2026, depreciating 0.61%. Interbank FX turnover rose to USD 86.15 million from USD 54.20 million, and the 7-day interbank rate edged up to 6.36%.
why: The Bank of Tanzania sets monetary conditions and manages the shilling, and weekly moves in its exchange rate, interbank rates and T-bill auctions shape the returns investors earn on Tanzanian local-currency assets.
